qti-assessment-item.title: Welcome to Statistics for the Social Sciences

div.p: This practice exam covers the first half of the course. It has three parts:

ol.li: Describing data: shape, spread and the normal distribution.
Relationships: regression, correlation, and why correlation is not causation.
Inference: ANOVA, errors in hypothesis testing and the central limit theorem.

div.p: Allow about 25 minutes. You may use a calculator. You can move freely between questions and change any answer until you finish.
Several questions are adapted from the ShareStats item bank, an open item bank for statistics education built by Dutch universities.
